what_i_found: I treated a browser jam build like a compact campaign shooter rather than a single-loop demo: four connected operations share one persistent operator, credits, XP, weapons, attachments and mission unlocks. The AEGIS memory sequence and intel gradually turn a presumed-dead teammate into the campaign's opposing commander, so progression and story advance together instead of resetting every run. The same procedural Three.js combat system then branches into Campaign, Survival, Extraction and Team Battle without imported meshes.
